svg.title: Steering-vector cosine across all datasets (higher is better)

cc:Work.dc:title: Steering-vector cosine across all datasets (higher is better)
cc:Work.dc:description: Figure-4-style grouped, hatched bars. Bars are held-out means and error bars are population standard deviations across three training seeds. A latent response coordinate is selected for each concept by one-to-one Pearson/Hungarian matching on cfc_train; its corresponding decoder axis is oriented by the response-correlation sign and evaluated on cfc_test. No absolute value or decoder-only reselection is applied. Gemma and Pythia are never pooled.

g.text: Train-only selection uses |corr(factor, latent response)|; the sign of that response correlation orients its decoder axis. Negative bars are retained and mean held-out anti-alignment—not missing data.
